title: Bulk link creation API
description: New capability built from scratch as new components on top of the existing service. Shows decomposition into a task DAG, multi-step implementation, parallel validation branches and the mandatory release sign-off.
requirement: Marketing needs to shorten many URLs at once for campaigns. Add a bulk endpoint that accepts up to 100 URLs (each with an optional custom alias) in one request and returns a result for every item, so that one bad URL does not fail the whole batch.
